newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil says Faeroes well finished.
newsitem.headline: Statoil says Faeroes well finished.

text.p: Norway's Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) said on Thursday drilling the Lopra-1 onshore well on the Faeroe Islands had yielded important geological information about the area.
No details on the information were given.
Recently completed on Sudaroey, this exploration well has been funded by 19 oil companies at a cost of roughly 44 million Norwegian crowns, the company Status Weekly magazine said.
The well is operated by Dansk Olie og Naturgas (Dong).
The first section of Lopra-1 was drilled in 1981 to about 2,000 metres as part of a scientific project to define the geology of the Faeroese continental shelf.
As part of preparations by the companies for the first Faeroese offshore licensing round, it has been extended to 3,560 metres, Status Weekly said.
